findings.description: none: The integration gate correctly binds each non-override acceptance to the canonical digest of the recorded result and fails closed for missing or mismatched digests. Tests cover both a verdict issued for another result and an unbound verdict.

none: Package acceptance now checks files_modified against the authoritative package definition rather than trusting the worker-echoed scope, applies deny patterns, and refuses acceptance when scope.write_allow is unavailable. Coverage includes broadened echoed scope, authoritative deny, and missing-scope cases.
none: Malformed failing verification steps without a name are reported using a placeholder instead of raising KeyError, allowing accept_package_result to return a refused verdict as required.
none: result_validator resolves its sibling package_acceptance module when loaded directly by file path. The installed-consumer portability suite passes in both supported runtime layouts.
